summary: The recording proves a TextEdit workflow that opens a new document with Cmd+N, then enters a runtime-provided note body into that new document’s “First Text View.” It does not demonstrate any formatting control, so teach a new example that includes clicking the specific formatting button after the input step.
lessons: Preserve the Cmd+N new-window step so each run starts a new TextEdit document.
Treat the note body as a runtime input parameter, not fixed text.
Use the newly created document’s “First Text View” as the input target.
To add formatting, demonstrate the exact formatting button click after text entry, including its semantic target details.
